compositional_generation.name: compositional_generation
compositional_generation.template: compile compositional constraints into visual program
prompt_rules: Use exactly the requested count for each object, no more and no fewer.
Keep repeated objects clearly separated and fully visible so they can be counted.
Avoid clutter, overlap, and occlusion unless the prompt explicitly asks for them.
Make every required object or relation explicit before adding style details.
Place repeated objects in a wide row or loose triangle with clear gaps.
For fruits or other small objects, use a plain surface and avoid bowls, baskets, piles, clusters, stacks, overlaps, or occlusion.
Keep each person fully visible and spaced apart so bodies remain countable.
Avoid crowding, pose overlap, and partial occlusion unless explicitly requested.
Keep every required category in its own clearly separated slots and preserve each category's exact count.
Render requested text verbatim and keep lettering legible.
Avoid decorative fonts that distort characters unless the user explicitly asks for them.

action_templates.jumping over: Action: {subject} airborne jumping over {target}; clear vertical gap; not side by side.
action_templates.chasing: Action: {subject} chasing {target}; motion direction visible; {target} ahead.
action_templates.playing with: Action: {subject} playing with {target}; visible interaction or contact.

prompt_rules: Make actions visually explicit with pose, contact, or motion cues rather than a static object lineup.
For jumping over, show the subject airborne above the target with clear vertical separation.
For chasing, show motion direction and the chased object ahead.
For playing with, show visible interaction or contact between the two objects.

attribute_binding.scene_preserving_presentation: Natural coherent scene preserving the original background, side/depth relations, and every named subject clearly visible.
attribute_binding.isolated_presentation: Large separated objects on a plain white background.
prompt_rules: Bind each attribute to exactly one target object and avoid attributing the same property to unrelated objects.
Keep the scene uncluttered and leave enough free space for each required object to be independently visible.
Use a simple composition with a clear foreground subject and stable framing.

prompt_enhancement.name: prompt_enhancement
prompt_enhancement.template: turn vague user intent into a concrete image-generation brief with composition, lighting, palette, quality, and negative controls
prompt_rules: Preserve the requested subject and scene before expanding style or atmosphere.
Make the focal subject, lighting direction, composition, and color palette explicit.
Add negative controls for readable text, logos, watermarks, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, and low-resolution artifacts.
